findings.pdf_says: ACCESS MODE IS { SEQUENTIAL [RELATIVE KEY IS data-name-1] / { RANDOM / [DYNAMIC] } RELATIVE KEY IS data-name-1 } -- the level-2 box encloses only the keyword DYNAMIC; the closing brace of the inner RANDOM/DYNAMIC brace is printed outside the box
findings.why_it_matters: The level-2 box marker closes after the inner brace's closing glyph, so the markdown puts the inner brace close inside the level-2 box. The same format on page 438 renders it correctly as `║ <u>DYNAMIC</u> ║ ╯`. Syntax meaning (RANDOM or DYNAMIC, with DYNAMIC level 2) is unchanged; this is a figure-glyph placement defect only.
